# Example drafts, not approved work briefs

These Bible and Holmes files exercise the shared brief contract. Their tone, eras and depiction rules are test data, not owner-approved production policy. Merging a code or fixture PR does not approve them for generation.

A real reading pass proposes `works/<work-id>/brief.json` in a separate, one-file brief PR. The owner reviews each depiction rule and the ordered style set; merging that PR records approval. Required structural preparation remains a separate readiness gate. This slice does not create production briefs or perform preparation.
